name: 1ToolRing
tagline: One key for thousands of pay-per-call tools: search, maps, prices, market data
description:
1ToolRing gives an agent one key and one prepaid balance for thousands of pay-per-call tools from third-party providers: live web search, keyword and SEO data, maps and places, shopping prices, stocks, crypto and FX, web pages, images and more.

The price of a run is shown before it is charged, and failed runs are never charged. There is no subscription: sign up, verify your email for a starter balance, then top up from as little as $1 by card.

Tools exposed over MCP:

- `discover_tools` (free) - search the catalogue by what you want to do
- `inspect_tool` (free) - read a tool's input schema and current price
- `run_tool` (paid) - execute a tool, with the price returned first
- `get_tool_run` (free) - poll a run's status and result

Auth is OAuth 2.1 (dynamic client registration + PKCE), so `cline mcp install` opens a 1ToolRing sign-in page. A 1ToolRing API key as a Bearer token also works if you prefer a static header.

env.name: ONETOOLRING_API_KEY
env.description: Optional 1ToolRing API key, if you would rather send a Bearer token than sign in with OAuth.

install.notes: Cline opens a 1ToolRing sign-in page to approve access. Free tools (discover_tools, inspect_tool, get_tool_run) work without spending anything; run_tool shows its price before it runs. Docs: https://docs.1toolring.com/overview/
